notes: Build-verb -> catalog-type mapping (owner 2026-07-10 generic build-mode). ONE generic entry BuildModeController.EnterBuildMode(BuildType) is parameterised by 'buildType'; each row maps it to the CatalogType(s) that feed its palette + the unlock-gated ids to filter. Loaded at startup by BuildCategoryRegistry (Village) via CanonicalJson (Resources-first, WebGL-safe). Keep the Resources + StreamingAssets copies byte-equal. 'buildType' / 'catalogTypes' are enum NAMES (StringEnumConverter). 'lockedIds' are catalog ids kept in the catalog but filtered out of THIS verb's palette until their unlock ships.
